Loss report: concourse -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config, input_mapping, tags) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.timeout: repo setting Timeout (set the repo timeout to 15m0s; Woodpecker limits the whole pipeline)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.tags: ref filter refs/tags/<pattern> (the tag name filter is written as a ref filter on the tag event)
